fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)

versions.change: First release of AXI specification v1.0
First release of AXI specification v2.0 (defines AXI4 and AXI4-Lite)
Public beta draft of AMBA AXI and ACE Protocol Specification — first description of AXI Coherency Extensions (ACE)
First release of AMBA AXI and ACE Protocol Specification — integrates AXI3 + AXI4 + first formal ACE release.
Second release of AMBA AXI and ACE Protocol Specification — clarifications, recommendations, and new optional features added via property declarations. Compatibility with Issue D maintained.

ace_lifecycle.subsequent_releases_outside_this_doc: Issues F (2017) and onwards added AXI5 / ACE5 / ACE5-Lite / ACE5-LiteDVM / ACE5-LiteACP variants in IHI 0022F/G/H (not covered by IHI 0022E).

deprecated_features.deprecated_in_version: AXI4 (and therefore in ACE which builds on AXI4)
deprecated_features.rationale: AXI4 enforces single-master-ordered write data on W; per-beat ID tagging removed.
Locked transactions complicate interconnect QoS; removed in AXI4 (1-bit AxLOCK retains Exclusive only).

ace_added_signals_vs_AXI4: AW channel: AWDOMAIN[1:0], AWSNOOP[2:0], AWBAR[1:0], AWUNIQUE (optional for WriteEvict)
R  channel: RRESP extended from [1:0] to [3:0] adding PassDirty + IsShared
B  channel: BRESP extended from [1:0] to [2:0] adding DataTransfer
Snoop address channel AC: ACVALID, ACREADY, ACADDR, ACSNOOP[3:0], ACPROT[2:0]
Snoop response channel CR: CRVALID, CRREADY, CRRESP[4:0]
Snoop data channel CD: CDVALID, CDREADY, CDDATA, CDLAST

backward_compat_considerations.axi3: AxLEN[3:0] — Burst_Length = AxLEN+1; 1..16 transfers for all burst types
backward_compat_considerations.axi4_ace: AxLEN[7:0] — Burst_Length = AxLEN+1; INCR up to 256 transfers

backward_compat_considerations.ace: RRESP[3:0] adds PassDirty + IsShared; AXI4-only masters connected to an ACE interconnect must tie or ignore RRESP[3:2].
BRESP[2:0] adds DataTransfer bit; AXI4 masters tie/ignore BRESP[2].
Required on AR/AW; AXI4-only masters connected to ACE interconnect must tie AxDOMAIN=0b00 (Non-shareable), AxSNOOP=0, AxBAR=0.

backward_compat_considerations.ace_full: Required for cached masters; ACE-Lite omits them entirely.
backward_compat_considerations.axi4_master_on_ace_interconnect: Snoop port tied off; master treated as Non-shareable.

backward_compat_considerations.ace: Required; must be a single-cycle pulse after the corresponding R/B handshake. AXI4-only masters tie RACK/WACK LOW; the ACE interconnect may treat them as always-ack.

interoperability_matrix.notes: Master treated as ACE-Lite at AxDOMAIN=Non-shareable; AC/CR/CD tied off.
Master issues coherent reads/writes without owning snoop port.
No snoop infrastructure; cannot maintain coherency.

evidence.quote: 03 June 2011 D-2c Public beta draft of AMBA AXI and ACE Protocol Specification; 28 October 2011 D First release of AMBA AXI and ACE Protocol Specification; 22 February 2013 E Second release of AMBA AXI and ACE Protocol Specification.
Issues B and C of this document included an AXI specification version, v1.0 and v2.0. These version number have been discontinued, to remove confusion with the AXI versions, AXI3 and AXI4.
The ACE protocol provides hardware cache coherency support and is an extension of the AXI4 protocol.
The ACE protocol introduces new signals on the AXI address channels (AxDOMAIN, AxSNOOP, AxBAR) and adds three snoop channels (AC, CR, CD), plus acknowledge signals (RACK, WACK).
